title: PRE-RAID MAP: ZONE NAMES 20 PX, EXIT AND KEYED ROOM NAMES 18 PX
why: After the map canvas was drawn at its real size the critic found the names too small to read from a couch. The zone names go to 20 px (shrinking to 14 to fit), the exit and keyed room names to 18 px.
now: The map names on the pre-raid page are bigger and easier to read.
